notes.title: Game Update and Maintenance Notice
notes.notes:
Dear Players,​
We sincerely apologize for the abrupt removal of premium packages. While our intention was to balance the game, it inadvertently compromised the experience for non-paying players seeking premium enjoyment. After discussions with the community, we are implementing the following adjustments:

​Package pop-up duration extended to 60 days (temporary solution to minimize code changes and potential bugs)
​**"Super Value Packages" consolidated into daily refresh format** (all weekly/monthly packages removed; daily purchase limit: 1)
​Red dot notification added: Displayed upon login if unsold packages exist, disappearing after first view (reactivates on next login if packages remain)
​**"Forbidden Trials" rewards standardized with Arena rewards** (only base coins and cosmetic titles; PVP focuses on fair competition)
Maintenance begins at ​00:50 (GMT+8) with 10-minute downtime. ​40,000 Gems will be compensated globally post-maintenance. We appreciate your patience and constructive feedback in community discussions.

notes.title: Announcement of Bug Fixes, Feature Adjustments, and Launching a New Server
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
Over the past two days, due to our oversight and some ill-considered functions and gameplay designs, several serious bugs and balance issues have arisen, resulting in a suboptimal experience for players and straying from our goal of fair play for non-paying users. We appreciate everyone for pointing out the issues and bugs. After careful discussion, we have decided to perform maintenance and adjustments on the afternoon of March 26. The fixes and adjustments are as follows:

1，Disable the pop-up gift pack feature. Although it was intended to provide a random surprise, it ended up causing more anxiety, so we have decided to cancel this feature.
2，Disable the gift pack feature. Since it was hidden deep within the interface, some players did not notice it, and misinformation led to some players not using the magic crystals as cost-effectively as possible. Thus, we have decided to cancel this feature as well.
3，We will promptly adjust resource outputs in the future so that more resources can be obtained fairly through the daily shop and the gacha system.
4，Fix the issue where the in-game compendium was not fully displayed due to a previous pool bug.
5，Fix the bug in the soul reforge system that allowed awakened souls to be exchanged by mistake. This was due to our oversight—the awakening system was not yet completed, and test data caused errors during reforging. After the fix, such errors will no longer occur, and the entrance to the awakening system will be temporarily disabled until the gameplay is fully developed.
6，The awakened souls obtained due to issue 5 are test data, and using them in-game may cause errors or freezes. During maintenance, they will be replaced with the corresponding SSSR souls.
7，Add volume control to the system settings menu to resolve the issue of the volume not being adjustable.
8，Add quick navigation buttons to the character artwork (kanban musume) interface, allowing direct access to the modification screens for character artwork and background boards.

The above maintenance and fixes will be carried out on March 26 at 17:30 (GMT+8), with an expected duration of 20 minutes. Once completed, a new server will be launched at 18:00 (GMT+8) so that players who experienced an unfair start or made poor cultivation decisions due to these issues can start over. The original server will remain available. After maintenance, all players on Server 1 will receive a compensation of 20,000 magic crystals.

Thank you for your understanding and feedback. We sincerely apologize once again—your criticism and understanding are the driving forces behind our progress.
